messages.subject: R / RJava / JGR / Deducer /Plot Builder and memory
parts:
Hi all,

I had issues with the Smooth Geom running out of memory in the Plot Builder with a dataset with 21138 rows:

=======
Error in predLoess(y, x, newx, s, weights, pars$robust, pars$span, pars$degree,  : 
  'Calloc' could not allocate memory (702828591 of 4 bytes)
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In predLoess(y, x, newx, s, weights, pars$robust, pars$span, pars$degree,  :
  Reached total allocation of 2047Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In predLoess(y, x, newx, s, weights, pars$robust, pars$span, pars$degree,  :
  Reached total allocation of 2047Mb: see help(memory.size)
=======

Setting memory.limit in JGR fixes this:
memory.limit(size = 32000)

My machine is Win7/64 with 64Gb ram, setup:

sessionInfo() 
R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
[[ ..etc..etc.. ]]
other attached packages:
 [1] XLConnect_0.2-9     XLConnectJars_0.2-9 foreign_0.8-61     
 [4] Deducer_0.7-7       MASS_7.3-35         car_2.0-22         
 [7] ggplot2_1.0.0       JGR_1.7-16          iplots_1.1-7       
[10] JavaGD_0.6-1        rJava_0.9-6        
JGR2.exe is my launcher.

Questions:

1.
How can I run memory.limit(size=32000) during startup?
I put it in RProfile.site as,
.First <- function(){
 memory.limit(size=32000)
}

However I get an error 'could not find function "memory.limit" ' during startup (if you start up using JGR2.exe, JGR simply won't start, you have to launch R 3.1.2 to see the error).
I'm guessing the library that contains memory.limit isn't started before .First is run during startup. I don't know how to work around this. Can anybody advise?

2. 
Processing 21k rows with the Smooth geom loess takes time, I know it does. Deducer keeps hitting me with the Cancel dialogue:
--------------
Cancel R Process
This R process is taking some time.
Would you like to cancel it?
Yes No
--------------
I realise this dialogue is useful if you make a crazy mistake and something goes into an infinite loop, but in this instance, it's incredibly annoying. I have to click 'No' about 4 times before the calculations are done. Can it be disabled?

thanks all,
best regards,
Kieran
